rationale: Substantial governance architecture converged this round (unconditional closure guarantee, redundancy floor, graduated mechanism, dividend symmetry bounded to term), but the core arithmetic question—whether labour package plus non-labour lever actually closes the quantified gap—remains unresolved pending the plant-level breakdown and firm non-labour sizing that all parties agree is now the blocking item, and new substantive issues (product-allocation as shadow closure lever) just emerged and need testing.
